messages:
Maya (PM): Quick decision thread: we need a firm scope for the Console observability rollout. Focus areas: dashboard templates, trace hook semantics, per-tenant cost attribution model, and error analytics MVP. Need a tight plan to pilot with 3 customers.
Arjun (Eng): Proposal: ship 3 dashboard templates (overview, cost by route, error spike timeline), tracing hook adds tenant_id + route + model_version. Sampling: support both probabilistic sampling and error-triggered capture. Error-triggered capture should keep X traces per error signature.
Priya (SRE): Ops constraints: error-triggered capture is better for signal but beware amplification loops. Default probabilistic sample_rate 0.5% globally, error-triggered capture only for 5 traces/min per tenant, and a hard cap of 1000 traces/day per tenant. Auto-throttle when trace ingress > 70% of allocated quota.
Ben (Data): Cost attribution: two-phase approach. Phase A (launch): estimated per-tenant cost from aggregated metrics (tokens, duration, model_unit_price) with a labeled confidence score. Phase B: exact per-span attribution for billing reconciliation (schema change + 2 sprints). We'll provide a CSV export from Phase A for finance.
Zoe (Design): UX decision: show "Estimated spend" card with a tooltip explaining confidence. For tracing UI: sampled trace viewer with short summary header (tenant, route, model, sample_reason). Keep trace snippets < 10s by default.
Nate (CS): Customers (AcmeHealth, FinTrack, NovaApps) prefer an export and an assurance that estimates won't be used for billing until exact mode is on. They asked for a pilot mode where we can increase sampling for a specific tenant for 48h.
Maya (PM): Draft launch acceptance criteria: 
- Dashboards: 3 templates render with synthetic and pilot customer data 
- Tracing: tenant_id tagging + model_version in spans; default probabilistic sampling 0.5%; error-triggered capture active behind flag 
- Cost: Phase A estimated per-tenant monthly and per-route, CSV export available, "confidence" indicator present 
- Errors: top-10 error signatures surfaced, ability to view up to N sampled traces per signature 
- Ops & Safety: per-tenant daily trace cap, auto-throttle at 70% quota, pilot rollout to 3 customers only
(Need ack from Eng/SRE/Data/Design/CS)
Arjun (Eng): Ack from Eng. Implementation notes: tenant_id needs to be threaded into the request pipeline; model_version is in the runtime metadata already. Error-triggered capture will tap into our existing anomaly detector; estimate 1 week to get into CI.
Priya (SRE): Ack from SRE. Blocker: storage & egress cost if pilot expands. We must gate per-tenant escalation behind support approval and require a manual review for >10x baseline sampling. Also add alert to #eng-oncall when daily trace count for any tenant > 50% of cap.
Ben (Data): Ack from Data. I'll build the aggregated table and a job to compute estimates + confidence band. CSV export endpoint: I'll expose as /api/v1/console/costs/export. Deliverable ETA: 3 days for Phase A schema and sample data.
Zoe (Design): Ack from Design. I'll post mocks for the 3 templates and the confidence pill in this thread by EOD. Will also add microcopy explaining "estimated" tag.
Nate (CS): I'll line up the 3 pilot customers and prep support playbook. Also collecting use-cases for CSV format (QBR, chargebacks).
Maya (PM): Decisions: ship Phase A (estimated cost + dashboards + sampled traces) behind feature flag to 3 pilot customers. Keep conservative defaults (0.5% sample_rate, daily cap 1000 traces/tenant). Error-capture enabled behind a "pilot" flag. Action owners/deadlines: 
- Arjun: PR for tenant_id + model_version tagging + sampling hooks (owner) 60% CI coverage required  due in 6 days.
- Priya: throttle/alerting rules + escalation flow (owner)  due in 5 days.
- Ben: aggregated cost table + CSV export + confidence calc (owner)  due in 3 days.
- Zoe: dashboard + confidence pill mocks (owner)  due EOD today.
- Nate: pilot customer list + support playbook (owner)  due in 2 days.
Arjun (Eng): Will open branch feature/console-obs-phaseA and link CI. Note: we'll wire a short retention TTL for sampled traces (7 days) to limit storage.
deploy-bot: build/ci-pipeline #620 queued for branch feature/console-obs-phaseA (1761234705)
Priya (SRE): Add-on operational ask: add a synthetic load test to the pipeline that simulates 10x pilot sampling so we can validate throttles before rollout.
Ben (Data): I'll include a sample dataset from FinTrack to validate the confidence bands.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. We'll hold a follow-up check-in after PR green and mocks posted. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here and notify #eng-oncall.
